questions.questionText: The mirror formula is:
questions.solution: Mirror formula: 1/f = 1/v + 1/u.

questions.questionText: Total internal reflection occurs when light travels from:
questions.optionB: Denser to rarer medium at angle greater than critical angle
questions.solution: TIR occurs when light goes from denser to rarer medium at angle > critical angle.

questions.questionText: The critical angle for a medium of refractive index n is:
questions.solution: sin(C) = 1/n, so C = sin^-1(1/n).

questions.questionText: Power of a lens is measured in:
questions.solution: P = 1/f (in metres) and unit is dioptre (D).

questions.questionText: A concave mirror forms a real and inverted image when object is:
questions.solution: Object beyond C gives diminished real inverted image between F and C.

questions.questionText: Optical fibres work on the principle of:
questions.solution: Light undergoes repeated total internal reflection inside optical fibres.

questions.questionText: The magnifying power of a simple microscope is:
questions.solution: For image at near point: m = 1 + D/f where D = 25 cm.

questions.questionText: A convex lens of focal length 20 cm has power:
Snell's law states:
questions.solution: Snell's law: n1 sin i = n2 sin r.

questions.questionText: Dispersion of light is due to:
questions.optionB: Variation of refractive index with wavelength
questions.solution: Different wavelengths have different refractive indices causing dispersion.

questions.questionText: A prism disperses white light because:
questions.optionC: Light slows down equally for all colours
questions.solution: n varies with wavelength so different colours deviate differently.

questions.questionText: Magnifying power of an astronomical telescope in normal adjustment is:
questions.solution: M = fo/fe for telescope in normal adjustment.

questions.questionText: The image formed by a plane mirror is:
questions.solution: Plane mirror forms virtual, erect, laterally inverted image.

questions.questionText: Rainbow is formed due to:
questions.optionB: Dispersion and total internal reflection in water drops
questions.solution: Rainbow involves refraction, dispersion, and internal reflection in water drops.

questions.questionText: The lens maker's equation is:
questions.solution: Lens maker's equation: 1/f = (n-1)(1/R1 - 1/R2).

questions.questionText: For a compound microscope the final image is:
questions.solution: Compound microscope produces virtual, inverted, magnified final image.

The sky appears blue due to:
questions.solution: Blue light scatters more (proportional to 1/lambda^4) by Rayleigh scattering.

questions.questionText: Minimum deviation through a prism occurs when:
questions.optionB: Angle of incidence equals angle of emergence
questions.solution: At minimum deviation the ray passes symmetrically: i = e.

questions.questionText: Mirage is caused by:
questions.optionA: Total internal reflection due to temperature gradient in air
questions.solution: Hot air near ground has lower n; light undergoes TIR creating mirage.

questions.questionText: A convex mirror always forms:
questions.solution: Convex mirror always forms virtual, erect, diminished image.

questions.questionText: Chromatic aberration in a lens is due to:
questions.optionB: Dispersion of light by lens material
questions.solution: Different wavelengths focus at different points due to dispersion.

questions.questionText: The angular magnification of a telescope can be increased by:
questions.solution: M = fo/fe. Increase fo and decrease fe for higher magnification.

questions.questionText: Refractive index of a medium is:
questions.optionA: Speed of light in vacuum / speed in medium
questions.optionB: Speed in medium / speed in vacuum
questions.optionC: Wavelength in medium / wavelength in vacuum
questions.optionD: Frequency in medium / frequency in vacuum
questions.solution: n = c/v where c is speed in vacuum and v is speed in medium.

questions.questionText: The focal length of a concave mirror of radius R is:
questions.solution: f = R/2 for spherical mirrors.
